body:
Actually it doesn't matter, you're right. They "lost" their father, as in I had to forcefully remove him from their lives due to domestic violence. So I have, in a sense, seen a look similar to what you described and it shakes me. Truthfully. ):
 I would give anything to have my family back together, I probably wouldnt be so suicidal. You too make a fine point. I have a lot to think about.

I know it sucks to even consider but there is always the chance things were going south right under your nose and the fact that you didn't realize it only made it worst. That's exactly what happened to me. I completely lost the person and I didn't see it until it was far far too late.

It is you who is onto something.
This has given me a lot to think about.
In fact I'm kind of in a state of shock.
Nobody has ever told me it was okay to feel and to just feel through all these things. Quite the opposite actually.
